goal: A weekly workflow opens a PR bumping the pinned claude and pi versions in tests/e2e/hosts.json and runs L1, and a report script counts post-release fixes within 7 days with a v8.6-v9.1 baseline (Spec D3, D10) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S10; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: scripts/bump-e2e-hosts.ts rewrites tests/e2e/hosts.json from stubbed registry versions and leaves it byte-identical when versions are current; the weekly workflow file schedules it and opens a PR. Done looks like: tests/e2e-host-bump.test.ts covers the bump, the no-change case and the workflow contract.

scripts/release-escape-report.ts counts fix and repair commits and issues landing within 7 days after each fixture release tag and attributes them to that version; a fix after 7 days is not counted. Done looks like: tests/release-escape-report.test.ts covers in-window, out-of-window and baseline output.
